substrate.name: NOAA/NCCOS California benthic substrate compilation
substrate.horizontal_crs: NAD27 California Teale Albers; source .prj preserved
substrate.rights: Public NOAA data; attribution required by source use constraints
substrate.attribution: NOAA/NOS/NCCOS/CCMA/Biogeography Branch; Moss Landing Marine Laboratory, MMS and UCSB
substrate.limitations: Historical hard/soft interpretation of variable source resolution, not field validated. Fine-scale errors exist. No boulder dimensions, relief, kelp presence or current fish abundance are established by these polygons.

bathymetry.name: NCCOS Channel Islands merged multibeam bathymetry
bathymetry.rights: CC0-1.0; expressly dedicated in the archive ISO metadata
bathymetry.attribution: Sweeney, E.; Costa, B.; Caldow, C. (2025), NOAA NCEI accession 0304093; NOAA, USGS, MBARI, CSUMB and OET surveys
bathymetry.limitations: Merged acoustic measurements with linear depth shifts to overlapping NOAA hydrographic surveys and some IDW interpolation in the published source. The archive does not explicitly name a common vertical datum or supply per-cell uncertainty. Native output cell size is not original sensor resolution or boulder-measurement accuracy. Not for navigation. Individual cell acquisition years are not supplied.

kelp.name: CDFW 2016 aerial kelp canopy and subsurface classification
kelp.rights: Public CDFW distribution with CDFW attribution; bundled use constraints retained in the downloaded source archive
kelp.attribution: California Department of Fish and Wildlife; imagery and processing by Sandoval & Associates LLC
kelp.limitations: Dated 2016 surface-canopy and subsurface detections, not live kelp. Survey timing, ocean state, photo quality and missing imagery affect detection. No detection does not prove absence. Kelp boundaries are not bottom depth or rock boundaries.
